stem.text: The diagram shows a uniform beam PQ. The length of the beam is $3.0\,\text{m}$ and its weight is $50\,\text{N}$. The beam is supported on a pivot $1.0\,\text{m}$ from end P. A load of weight $W$ is hung from end P and the beam is in equilibrium.

stem.alt: Horizontal uniform beam with ends labelled P on the left and Q on the right. A load labelled W hangs from end P. A triangular pivot sits under the beam. Dimension arrows mark 1.0 m from P to the pivot and 3.0 m from P to Q.
